_comment: Sidecar for the What We'd Pay block. Build it with:
The database is the default. Anything in `overrides` wins; anything left
out is pulled live. Delete `overrides` entirely for a fully automatic
block, or set "mode": "manual" and drop `slug` to write every field by
hand. The build report prints which fields were pulled and which were
overridden, and warns when an override has drifted from the database.
Overridable fields: headline, subline, msrp, msrpSource, stealUnder,
If you override `msrp`, give `msrpSource` too — the database's source

overrides.note: Leave this out and the block uses bottle_prices.editorial_note. Set it when the issue needs a different argument than the bottle page makes.
